affinity.notes: Floating glyphs are discrete magical tools around a clearly physical cobra-humanoid body.

anatomy.notes: Cobra hood, four arms, torso, and coiled tail are clearly organized.

archetype.notes: Ritual controller or arcane caster communicates the script-specialist duty.

counterplay.notes: Raised glyphs and the horizontally held ritual focus clearly signal channeling, while the grounded coils imply limited mobility during the cast.

finish.notes: Refined teal-bronze materials and restrained magical accents.

framing.notes: Centered full-body composition with balanced spell props.

identity.notes: Multi-armed cobra naga identifies the Hooded Adept form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T4, not exact intended tier T3.
